import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.cluster import AgglomerativeClustering
from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Identify strong candidates by mean difference and t-test
    candidates = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        if feats.types[i] == 'clinical':
            continue  # Skip clinical features for this analysis
        mean_diff = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==1, i]) - np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==0, i])
        t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==1, i], feats.x[feats.y==0, i])
        if abs(mean_diff) > 0.3 and abs(t_stat) > 2.5 and p_val < 0.01:
            candidates.append((fid, abs(mean_diff), abs(t_stat)))
    
    if not candidates:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Sort by strength
    candidates.sort(key=lambda x: x[2], reverse=True)
    top_candidates = [c[0] for c in candidates[:10]]
    
    # Find correlated groups
    corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in top_candidates]].T)
    corr_matrix = np.abs(corr_matrix)
    
    # Cluster features with high correlation
    clustering = AgglomerativeClustering(n_clusters=None, 
                                       distance_threshold=0.6,
                                       linkage='average')
    cluster_labels = clustering.fit_predict(corr_matrix)
    
    # Select the largest cluster as our module
    unique_labels, counts = np.unique(cluster_labels, return_counts=True)
    if len(counts) == 0:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    largest_cluster = unique_labels[np.argmax(counts)]
    module_features = [top_candidates[i] for i in range(len(top_candidates)) 
                      if cluster_labels[i] == largest_cluster]
    
    if len(module_features) < 2:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Create weighted score from module features
    weights = np.array([np.abs(np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, feats.column(f)], feats.y)[0, 1]) 
                       for f in module_features])
    weights = weights / np.sum(weights)
    
    loadings = dict(zip(module_features, weights))
    
    # Return the design
    return Design(
        drivers=(module_features[0],) if module_features else (),
        columns=tuple(module_features),
        products=(),
        loadings=loadings
    )
